name: mitaoe-attendance-management-system
description: Production-grade College Attendance Management System for MIT Academy of Engineering, Pune (MERN Stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
